comment: Stage 6 RL state specification (src/rl_state.py). The frontend MUST NOT modify this definition.
normalization: sector ranges divided by radius_m; shares and densities already in [0,1]; importance/uncertainty in [0,1]
heading_convention: ego heading assumed +X (no heading signal in replay frames)
missing_value_policy: empty sector range = radius_m (normalized 1.0); no cells in radius = shares 0.0, mean importance 0.0, mean uncertainty 0.5; empty cell list raises ValueError
